en: An old black-and-white postcard depicting a large church with a tall spire and a distinctive clock tower, situated next to a grand building. The setting includes trees, a white fence, several houses, and a body of water in the foreground. On the back, there is handwritten text, a Swedish postage stamp, and addresses. The postcard is titled 'Sundsvall. Kyrkan och Flickskolan.'
